LITTLE MEE

When the afternoon breeze blows through the open window Master Chi Lu's little chimes swing side to side sounding out many pleasant tunes.
His favourite is The' Circle Song.

The little chimes play The Circle Dance by swinging around the back of thechimeplafes.
Each one has a brilliant note to chime.
Can you see IMAGINATIVE Little MEE?
She is the Orange coloured little chime.

Whenever they can the little chimes play
The Circle Dance for their grand old master He settles down onhiscolourfulmat,quietly entertaininlg his visitors, listening to his happy little chimes.

One evening as the breeze dropped and the visitors were leaving Little Mee leaned over to Tiny
Tee and said,
"Wouldn't it be great Tiny Tee, if we had another instrument for all of us to play We could make lots of new songs for Master Chi Lu".

Tiny Tee cautiously agreed because everyone knew
Little Mee was always making up crazy ideas.
Tiny Tee then leaned over to Hi Doh and said,
"It's probably Little Mee's crazy imagination, running wild!"
